description: Effective recoding between fixed-length tuples and their finite coordinate functions preserves both computable enumerability and decidability.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.tuple_recoding {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop) :
  (REPred R ↔ REPred fun v => R v.get) ∧ (ComputablePred R ↔ ComputablePred fun v => R v.get)
